description: ANSWERS "how did Rep. X vote on bill Y" / "what were X's last 20 votes" / "did X vote against the budget resolution" -- one member's recorded position (Yea, Nay, Present, Not Voting, or not on the roll) on roll calls, newest first -- House members from the U.S. House Clerk's roll-call votes, senators (chamber "senate") from the Congressional Record, where the Senate's roll calls are printed. Filter by `bill` (e.g. "H R 1"), `question_contains` (matched against question, bill number and description) or a roll range. Quorum calls, Speaker elections and Senate rolls whose record could not be derived are left out unless include_non_recorded is true. Every response names its chamber, congress, session, the last roll it covers and data_as_of. An unknown member or a Congress/session not held returns a named reason, never an empty list.

bill.description: Legislation number as the Clerk prints it, e.g. "H R 1", "H J RES 104", "S 2403" (punctuation and spacing ignored; exact match).

chamber.description: "house" (default) or "senate". The two chambers number their roll calls independently.

congress.description: Congress number, e.g. 119. Default: the newest held.

include_non_recorded.description: Include quorum calls and Speaker-election rolls (default false).

name.description: Surname as the Clerk prints it, e.g. "Pelosi"; combine with state when several members share it.

question_contains.description: Case-insensitive text to match in the vote question, bill number or description, e.g. "suspend the rules", "continuing appropriations".

session.description: 1 or 2. Default: the newest held for the default Congress.

state.description: Two-letter state code to disambiguate a surname.

name: member_vote_positions
title: Member Vote Positions
